issues.issue: Did the officer have jurisdiction to assess the bona fides of a marriage in a skilled worker application under s. 4 of the Regulations?
issues.applicant_position: Section 4 applies only to family class; the officer had no jurisdiction to assess marriage bona fides in a skilled worker case.
issues.result_quote: I conclude that it is not limited to family class sponsorships. Section 4 of the Regulations applies to family members of an applicant in the skilled worker class.

issues.issue: Did the officer deny procedural fairness by not giving notice of the examination's purpose and not considering further documents?
issues.applicant_position: The officer gave no notice that the marriage's genuineness was at issue and refused a chance to submit further documents.
issues.result_quote: I conclude that the Officer denied the applicants’ procedural fairness when, having not given advance notice of the purpose of the examination

issues.issue: Did the officer err in concluding that the adult applicants' marriage was not genuine?
issues.applicant_position: The marriage was genuine; the officer erred in finding otherwise.
issues.result_quote: Deciding as I have on the question of procedural fairness, I need not address this issue.
